corrections.section: Prophet addressing Abu Dharr and remaining traits of Jahiliyyah
corrections.romanizedExact: Aaaei abu zaer kai cxai karthaa teamis majjjei hinx zaryee baiizteii  cxai amnx che aaaez te jahaaaltech keanh aadaet.
corrections.provisionalScript: اے ابوذر! کیا ژےٚ کٔرِتھ تَمس ماجہِ ہٕنٛز ذٔریعہٕ بے عزتی؟ ژےٚ منٛز چھِ اَز تہِ جاہلیتٕچ کینہہ عادَتھ۔

corrections.section: Those in your care are your brothers and Allah placed them under authority
corrections.romanizedExact: Tehend ghulaam che tuhuend bhaaaie.    Alllah talllhan che tem tuhendis ikhtiyaaras manx thoveimit.
corrections.provisionalScript: تُہُنٛدۍ غلام چھِ تُہُنٛدۍ بای؛ اللہ تعالیٰن چھِ تِم تُہُنٛدِ اختیارَس منٛز تھاومٕتۍ۔

corrections.section: Feed and clothe those under your authority
corrections.romanizedExact: Yous shakahs pannnis ikhtiyaaras manz bhaoooie rataan chu teamis pazee su kheawoun yous su paeenei kheawaaen chu.  Te su lagnawpun (waering) yous su paaanas lagaan chu
corrections.provisionalScript: یُس شَخص پَننِس اختیارَس منٛز بای رَٹان چھُ، تَمس پَزِ سُہ کھَلاوُن یُس سُہ پان کھؠوان چھُ، تہٕ سُہ لَگناوُن یُس سُہ پانَس لَگان چھُ۔

notes: Exact Romanized owner expressions retained, including the parenthetical explanation of wearing. Perso-Arabic spelling is a proposal and not a user-approved transcription; leave the remaining narration unchanged.
